text: 10 OVERDOSAGE Minocycline is not removed in significant quantities by hemodialysis or peritoneal dialysis. In case of overdosage, discontinue minocycline, treat symptomatically, and institute supportive measures. Call Poison Control Center at 1-800 222-1222 for the latest recommendations.

10 OVERDOSAGE Minocycline is not removed in significant quantities by hemodialysis or peritoneal dialysis.
